attentionReasons.rootCause: vehicleNeedsTrackingAttention used flags + non-license alert_items, but the list showed generic chips/flags so officers could not see why a vehicle was in דרוש טיפול.
attentionReasons.change: trackingAttentionReasons() is the same source of truth as the counter. Compact chips: טסט פג תוקף / טסט בחודש הקרוב / ביטוח / טיפול / תקלה / ליקוי / תאונה / מוסך.

urgentVsExpired.rootCause: alertInScope('urgent') and dashboard isDueOrUpcomingInWindow treated daysLeft < 0 as urgent, mixing פג תוקף into דחוף.
